project_name.justification: The primary project of interest is explicitly named throughout the documents, for example: "Discovery Announces Transformational Acquisition of Newmont’s Porcupine Complex" and "...to acquire from a wholly owned subsidiary of Newmont Corporation (“Newmont”) 100% of Newmont’s interest in its Porcupine Operations (the “Porcupine Complex” or “Porcupine”)..."

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified as Discovery Silver Corp. in the headline and body of the text: "Discovery Silver Corp. (TSX: DSV, OTCQX: DSVSF) (“Discovery” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce that it has entered into a definitive agreement (the “Agreement”) to acquire from a wholly owned subsidiary of Newmont Corporation (“Newmont”) 100% of Newmont’s interest in its Porcupine Operations (the “Porcupine Complex”)..."

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the buyer, Discovery Silver Corp., is identified multiple times: "Tony Makuch, Discovery’s CEO, commented..." and in the signature block "Tony Makuch, P.Eng President, CEO & Director".

interest_acquired_percent.justification: Discovery Silver Corp. is acquiring a 100% interest in the project: "...to acquire from a wholly owned subsidiary of Newmont Corporation (“Newmont”) 100% of Newmont’s interest in its Porcupine Operations (the “Porcupine Complex”)..."

primary_commodity.justification: The project is described as a gold operation: "Establishes Discovery as a new Canadian gold producer with multiple operations in one of the world’s most prolific gold camps..."

verified_article_link.justification: The source documents do not contain a direct, stable URL for a specific news article. The provided links are either trackers for SEDAR+ or generic corporate website links.

currency.justification: The currency for the transaction is specified as US dollars: "All dollar amounts are in US dollars unless otherwise specified."

cash_payments_raw.justification: The total cash consideration is the sum of the closing cash and deferred cash payments: $200 million at closing and $150 million deferred. "The consideration to Newmont for the Transaction consists of $200 million in cash (the “Closing Cash Consideration”)... and $150 million of deferred consideration (the “Deferred Consideration”) to be paid in four annual cash payments of $37.5 million commencing on December 31, 2027."

share_payments_raw.justification: The equity portion of the consideration is valued at $75 million. "The consideration to Newmont for the Transaction consists of... $75 million payable in common shares of Discovery (the “Closing Equity Consideration”)..."

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The cash and share payment components are explicitly broken down, so this combined field is not applicable as per the extraction hierarchy.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The management information circular specifies the exact number of shares to be issued for the equity consideration: "The Purchase Price consists of US$200 million payable in cash and US$75 million payable through the issuance of an aggregate of 119,716,667 Common Shares (the 'Consideration Shares')..."

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: Warrants are mentioned, but they are being issued to Franco-Nevada as part of a financing package, not to the seller (Newmont) as part of the acquisition consideration. "Discovery will issue to Franco-Nevada approximately 3.9 million warrants (the “Franco Warrants”)..."

option_payments_raw.justification: There is no mention of options being issued as part of the acquisition consideration.

issued_share_price.justification: The share price is tied to a public offering price of C$0.90, which is stated to be approximately $0.63 USD. A footnote in the Newmont release confirms this applies to the deal shares: "To be issued to Newmont at the same price as the bought public deal offering." The public offering price is stated as: "an issue price of C$0.90 (approximately $0.63) per Subscription Receipt (the “Issue Price”)".

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: There is no mention of an exploration commitment defined in meters.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The text mentions "total planned exploration capital from 2025 to 2030 totaling $69 million," but this is described as a future plan for the company, not a contractual commitment to the seller as part of the acquisition terms.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: A new Net Smelter Royalty is being created as part of a financing package with Franco-Nevada to fund the transaction, not acquired from or retained by the seller, Newmont. "The $400 million of royalty and debt financing from Franco-Nevada includes: $200 million related to a 2.25% LOM net smelter return royalty..."

coverage_area_raw.justification: The total land position of the acquired complex is stated as 140,000 hectares. "Discovery plans to commit significant resources to exploration drilling at the 140,000-hectare total land position comprising the Porcupine Complex..."

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the coverage area is specified as hectares. "...at the 140,000-hectare total land position..."

resource_size.value: Measured & Indicated Mineral Resources of 3.9 million ounces (69.7 million tonnes (“Mt”) at an average grade of 1.76 grams per tonne (“g/t”) gold) and Inferred Mineral Resources of 12.5 million ounces (254.5 Mt at 1.53 g/t gold)
resource_size.justification: A summary of the mineral resources is provided in the text: "Large base of Mineral Resources including Measured & Indicated Mineral Resources of 3.9 million ounces (69.7 million tonnes (“Mt”) at an average grade of 1.76 grams per tonne (“g/t”) gold) and Inferred Mineral Resources of 12.5 million ounces (254.5 Mt at 1.53 g/t gold)."

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer's ticker and exchange are provided in the first press release: "Discovery Silver Corp. (TSX: DSV, OTCQX: DSVSF)".
